standard.label: neuroSHARE Standard Intro
standard.content:
Welcome to the neuroSHARE Survey

This survey will take about 20–25 minutes to complete.

Expect assignments focused on:

  • Speech & Voice
  • Sleep
  • Colour vision
  • Hearing
  • Thinking skills

standard.label: neuroSHARE Standard Instructions
standard.content:
Before you start

  • Find a quiet space: Sit at a table in a room without interruptions. Close any windows and turn off the TV.
  • Disconnect headphones: Use your device's built-in microphone and speakers.
  • Check your device battery and internet connection: Ensure stable internet and sufficiently charged battery.

standard.label: neuroSHARE Standard Consent
standard.content:
Informed Consent

Thank you for taking part in the neuroSHARE study.

Your participation is entirely voluntary. You may withdraw at any time, without giving a reason and without any consequences.

All data collected will be:

  • Anonymised and stored securely
  • Used only for research purposes
  • Not shared with third parties without your explicit consent

If you have any questions about the study, please contact the research team before continuing.

By checking the box below and continuing, you confirm that you have read and understood the information above and voluntarily agree to participate.
